mu_name_from: OpenMU Version075 Items/Weapons.cs:110 and mu.db's items row (group 1, index 4) name it the Elven Axe against Item/Axe05.bmd.
why_this_one: Drop level 26: the Elite Yeti leaves it, and the Ice Queen as an excellent. The Wizard's and the Elf's, not the Knight's. See docs/devias-drops.md.
stance_from: ZzzCharacter.cpp:356-360: a sword, axe or mace that is not TwoHand (width 1) stands PLAYER_STOP_SWORD, and leaves the shield hand free.
sheet_from: Data/Item/Axes06.OZJ (28x28) on 36 triangles and Axes06.OZT (64x64, alpha) on 2, from MuMain; one stem, so each half is decoded with the extension it stands for, as the Elven Shield's.
material_note: A steel head on a timber haft. Axes06.tga carries the head's crescent outline with 54% cut away and is declared a cut-out.
cutout_note: Declared, not sniffed (tools/asset.sh reads `cutout` from the recipe). Without it the card draws as a solid quad.
material_overrides_note: Steel's own 0.2 mirrored the grass: in the studio the head went black from above and the shaft flared white at grazing sun, the Gladius's fault (black at 0.2, right at 0.55) and the Salamander's in this batch.

islands.note: one face of the head: neutral grey (220,220,220 edge, 59-90 cast body), chroma 5.
the haft, -25 to 14: orange-brown at chroma 103 end to end (154,93,53) with no banding. Timber.
the other face of the head, the same samples as island 0.

the head's cut-out silhouette on Axes06.tga: a silver crescent with a tiger-striped inlay (the sample at its middle lands on the brown stripe, 106,74,65). The blade is the surface; the stripe is paint. As steel it came out a black crescent in the studio at roughness 0.2 and at 0.45: the card is painted darker than the grey bars that set steel's reflectance from the art, and a broad dark painted metal face is plate_steel's case (painted_steel.json's warning).
